body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/fixes.md (entry dated 2026-09-22).

`script/dogfood-check.sh:303,308` and `script/dogfood-bind-range_test.sh` (18 call sites) invoke `rg` directly. On a host without ripgrep the scripts do not fail closed with a clear message — they emit `rg: command not found` mid-run and the caller reports an unrelated failure. Observed in a Linux container at 82a113a: `cmd/corvint` `TestGoOnlyContextAbstentionRemainsClosed` (GOC-V0-009) and `TestLocalCompletionRealEvidenceWorkflow/LCP-V0-007` both fail for this reason alone, LCP-V0-007 surfacing as a misleading `dogfood-report-drift`. Done looks like: either a single preflight in the shared script prologue that exits with a named `unsupported-environment` reason when `rg` is absent, or POSIX `grep` equivalents; plus `rg` recorded as a documented prerequisite wherever the gate environment is described.

completion.reason: BUILD-LOG gate-affected floor and dogfood rg dependency; script/dogfood-*.sh refuse with unsupported-environment-missing-rg.

title: script: the dogfood shell scripts hard-depend on `rg` with no preflight or fallback
